add_subdirectory(Freetype)
add_subdirectory(ShapeLib)
add_subdirectory(Proj4)
add_subdirectory(Jpeg)
add_subdirectory(TiffLib)
# expat (XML parser of the OSM converter): the bundled sources as a static library, only the library itself
# (the options are normal variables, expat takes them instead of its cache defaults - policy CMP0077)
set(EXPAT_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(EXPAT_MSVC_STATIC_CRT ON)        # /MT, /MTd as the rest of the project (CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY)
set(EXPAT_BUILD_TOOLS OFF)
set(EXPAT_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF)
set(EXPAT_BUILD_TESTS OFF)
set(EXPAT_BUILD_DOCS OFF)
set(EXPAT_BUILD_FUZZERS OFF)
set(EXPAT_BUILD_PKGCONFIG OFF)
set(EXPAT_ENABLE_INSTALL OFF)
add_subdirectory(expat)
# without XML_STATIC the expat.h of MSVC declares the functions __declspec(dllimport)
target_compile_definitions(expat PUBLIC XML_STATIC)
# linked into the shared JNI library
set_target_properties(expat PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
